meta.name: competitor-analysis
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "analyze competitors" or "竞品分析"; benchmarks competitor keywords, content, backlinks, AI citations, and traffic share into strengths, weaknesses, and an action plan. Not for a pairwise topic-coverage gap map — use content-gap-analysis. 竞品分析/竞争对手

copy.tagline: 分析竞品关键词、内容、流量，生成优劣势与行动方案。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想了解竞争对手的线上表现并制定应对策略。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析竞品的 SEO 和 GEO 策略，包括关键词、内容、外链、AI 引用和流量份额，输出一份包含优势、劣势和行动计划的竞品简报。
howto.when: 当你要求“分析竞品”或“竞品分析”，或者询问竞品 SEO 策略、域名对比时触发。

say.text: 分析竞品 example.com 的 SEO 策略。
say.note: Claude 会收集数据并生成竞品简报。

say.text: 对比我的网站 mysite.com 和竞品 A、竞品 B。
say.note: Claude 会进行多竞品对比分析。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude analyzes competitor SEO and GEO strategies, including keywords, content, backlinks, AI citations, and traffic share, producing a prioritized brief with strengths, weaknesses, and an action plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "analyze competitors" or "竞品分析", or inquire about competitor SEO strategy, domain comparison, etc.

say_en.note: Claude will gather data and produce a competitor brief.

say_en.text: Compare my site mysite.com against competitor A and competitor B.
say_en.note: Claude will perform a multi-competitor comparison.
